props.label: Painting built for Upper North Shore homes
props.html:
Local painters, done properly

Painting built for Upper North Shore homes

The Upper North Shore is leafy, high-set and heavily wooded. That looks lovely and it is hard on paint. Homes here cop strong UV, sudden rain, deep tree shade and a constant drift of leaf litter, so exterior coatings have to be prepped thoroughly and chosen to resist moisture and mould. We know the housing stock too, from Federation weatherboards through brick and rendered homes to newer estates and apartment blocks.

We are a small, licensed team that shows up when we say we will. You get one clear fixed-price quote, tidy workmanship, and a crew that treats your place like it is worth protecting. No call-out fee, no vague estimates, no mess left behind. Two decades of work across the LGA sits behind every finish.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Where we work

Suburbs we paint across the LGA

We cover all 16 suburbs in the local government area. Here is what to expect in each pocket, from heritage streets to bushland-edge estates.

Beecroft 2119 & Cheltenham 2119 · Heritage precinct

Beecroft & Cheltenham heritage painting

Beecroft and Cheltenham sit inside a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so the housing is period timber and render on leafy blocks. That calls for gentle preparation, timber restoration where it is needed, and heritage-sympathetic colour schemes rather than a quick once-over. We work carefully here. Older weatherboard and detailed trims reward a painter who slows down, and we colour-match to suit the street without flattening a home’s character.

Waitara 2077 · Rail and apartment belt

Waitara painting

Waitara runs from unit blocks near the station to homes around the hospital precinct. We handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas, and we keep noise and access tidy for shared buildings.

Asquith 2077 · Northern rail corridor

Asquith painting

Asquith is mostly post-war brick and weatherboard family homes. Solid, honest houses that paint up beautifully with the right prep. We refresh tired exteriors and brighten interiors without fuss.

Hornsby Heights 2077 · Bushland edge

Hornsby Heights painting

High-set and tree-lined, Hornsby Heights homes take real sun and shade. Weatherboard and rendered exteriors here need mould-resistant coatings and a proper wash-and-prep before a brush touches them.

Cherrybrook 2126 · Planned estates

Cherrybrook painting

Cherrybrook is largely 1980s and newer estate housing, so think rendered facades, feature walls and full-exterior repaints. We modernise dated colour schemes and seal render against the weather.

Pennant Hills 2120 · Established homes

Pennant Hills painting

Pennant Hills has established station-precinct homes and older weatherboard stock. We repaint fascias, eaves and window frames that have weathered, and we bring interiors back to life room by room.

Thornleigh 2120 · Rail corridor mix

Thornleigh painting

Thornleigh mixes brick, weatherboard and newer builds along the rail line. It is a busy local painter market, so we compete on tidy work and a fixed price you can trust, not on cut corners.

Normanhurst 2076 & Westleigh 2120 · Family suburbs

Normanhurst & Westleigh painting

Normanhurst runs to interwar and post-war homes near the rail line, where we handle full repaints, ceilings and trim work with careful masking. Westleigh is quieter and greener, mostly 1970s and 1980s brick and timber family houses on the bush edge, where exteriors need durable, weather-ready coatings. Both suburbs get the same fixed-price quoting and the same crew.

Mount Colah 2079 · Bushland fringe

Mount Colah painting

Mount Colah sits on the bushland fringe, and our service radius here also takes in nearby Mount Kuring-Gai. Family homes with plenty of timber, so prep and protection matter.

Berowra 2081 · Northern bushland

Berowra painting

At the LGA’s northern edge, Berowra and adjoining Berowra Heights are semi-rural and heavily treed. Exteriors here work hard against moisture and leaf debris, so we prep thoroughly and coat for the long run.

North Epping 2121 · Bushland enclave

North Epping painting

North Epping is a quiet residential pocket bordering Lane Cove National Park, full of solid mid-century homes. Shaded, damp-prone exteriors here benefit from mould-resistant systems and unhurried preparation.

Across Beecroft and Cheltenham we paint character homes the way they deserve: careful surface prep, timber restoration, and historically appropriate colour schemes that respect a conservation-area streetscape. We keep the detail sharp and the finish authentic.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Booking, quotes & cover

Common questions before you book

The practical stuff: how quotes work, what is included, and how we are covered.

How do I get a quote for painting on the Upper North Shore?
Call us on 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We book a time, come out to see the job, and give you a fixed price in writing. The quote is free and there is no call-out fee.
Is the quote really free, with no call-out fee?
Yes. The site visit and the written quote cost you nothing, and we do not charge a call-out fee to come and look. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.
How does your fixed-price quoting work?
We assess the full scope on site, then quote one fixed figure that covers preparation, materials and labour. The price we write down is the price you pay. If you later add work, we quote that separately and clearly before we start it.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold NSW Licence 315254C and our crews are fully insured. We are happy to confirm our licence and insurance details before work begins, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How far ahead should I book?
It depends on the season and the size of the job, so the best move is to call early. We will give you a realistic start window when we quote, and we confirm dates in writing rather than leaving you guessing.
What paint brands do you use?
We use quality, trade-grade products suited to the surface and the conditions, including mould-resistant exterior systems for bushland-edge homes. If you have a preferred brand or an existing colour to match, tell us and we will work to it.
Do you offer colour advice before we commit?
Yes. We are happy to talk through colour and finish options during the quote, including how a scheme will sit on your home and street. For heritage streets we steer toward palettes that suit the era and the area.

props.label: Painting questions specific to the area
props.html:
Local questions

Painting questions specific to the area

Coverage, heritage streets, bushland exteriors and local approvals.

Which Upper North Shore suburbs do you cover?
All 16 suburbs in the local government area: Asquith, Beecroft, Berowra, Berowra Heights, Cheltenham, Cherrybrook, Hornsby, Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Mount Kuring-Gai, Normanhurst, North Epping, Pennant Hills, Thornleigh, Waitara and Westleigh.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Beecroft and Cheltenham?
Yes, and it is one of the things we do best. Beecroft and Cheltenham sit in a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so we use careful surface preparation, timber restoration where needed, and heritage-appropriate colour schemes that suit the streetscape.
Can you handle bushland-edge exterior painting in Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Berowra and North Epping?
We can. Tree-lined, high-set homes get strong sun, shade, moisture and leaf debris. We prep thoroughly and use mould-resistant coatings and durable finishes made for timber, brick and rendered surfaces so the paint lasts through the seasons.
Do you paint apartments and strata blocks in Waitara?
Yes. Waitara has a lot of unit stock, and we handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas. For strata we give clear written scopes and keep access and noise organised for residents and committees.
How long does an exterior repaint take around here?
It depends on the size of the home, the surface condition and the weather, so we will not guess blind. When we quote on site we give you a realistic timeline for your specific job, and we confirm the dates in writing before we start.
Do you do commercial and office painting across the LGA?
Yes. We paint offices, shopfronts, warehouses and mixed-use commercial sites, scheduled around your trading hours to keep disruption down. Ask for a fixed-price commercial quote when you call.
Do local council heritage rules affect painting my home?
In conservation areas like Beecroft and Cheltenham, external changes can be subject to Hornsby Shire Council heritage controls, so colour and finish choices matter. We work within those expectations and can point you to the right council resources if you need to check before you start.

Painting built for Upper North Shore homes

The Upper North Shore is leafy, high-set and heavily wooded. That looks lovely and it is hard on paint. Homes here cop strong UV, sudden rain, deep tree shade and a constant drift of leaf litter, so exterior coatings have to be prepped thoroughly and chosen to resist moisture and mould. We know the housing stock too, from Federation weatherboards through brick and rendered homes to newer estates and apartment blocks.

We are a small, licensed team that shows up when we say we will. You get one clear fixed-price quote, tidy workmanship, and a crew that treats your place like it is worth protecting. No call-out fee, no vague estimates, no mess left behind. Two decades of work across the LGA sits behind every finish.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Where we work

Suburbs we paint across the LGA

We cover all 16 suburbs in the local government area. Here is what to expect in each pocket, from heritage streets to bushland-edge estates.

Beecroft 2119 & Cheltenham 2119 · Heritage precinct

Beecroft & Cheltenham heritage painting

Beecroft and Cheltenham sit inside a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so the housing is period timber and render on leafy blocks. That calls for gentle preparation, timber restoration where it is needed, and heritage-sympathetic colour schemes rather than a quick once-over. We work carefully here. Older weatherboard and detailed trims reward a painter who slows down, and we colour-match to suit the street without flattening a home’s character.

Waitara 2077 · Rail and apartment belt

Waitara painting

Waitara runs from unit blocks near the station to homes around the hospital precinct. We handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas, and we keep noise and access tidy for shared buildings.

Asquith 2077 · Northern rail corridor

Asquith painting

Asquith is mostly post-war brick and weatherboard family homes. Solid, honest houses that paint up beautifully with the right prep. We refresh tired exteriors and brighten interiors without fuss.

Hornsby Heights 2077 · Bushland edge

Hornsby Heights painting

High-set and tree-lined, Hornsby Heights homes take real sun and shade. Weatherboard and rendered exteriors here need mould-resistant coatings and a proper wash-and-prep before a brush touches them.

Cherrybrook 2126 · Planned estates

Cherrybrook painting

Cherrybrook is largely 1980s and newer estate housing, so think rendered facades, feature walls and full-exterior repaints. We modernise dated colour schemes and seal render against the weather.

Pennant Hills 2120 · Established homes

Pennant Hills painting

Pennant Hills has established station-precinct homes and older weatherboard stock. We repaint fascias, eaves and window frames that have weathered, and we bring interiors back to life room by room.

Thornleigh 2120 · Rail corridor mix

Thornleigh painting

Thornleigh mixes brick, weatherboard and newer builds along the rail line. It is a busy local painter market, so we compete on tidy work and a fixed price you can trust, not on cut corners.

Normanhurst 2076 & Westleigh 2120 · Family suburbs

Normanhurst & Westleigh painting

Normanhurst runs to interwar and post-war homes near the rail line, where we handle full repaints, ceilings and trim work with careful masking. Westleigh is quieter and greener, mostly 1970s and 1980s brick and timber family houses on the bush edge, where exteriors need durable, weather-ready coatings. Both suburbs get the same fixed-price quoting and the same crew.

Mount Colah 2079 · Bushland fringe

Mount Colah painting

Mount Colah sits on the bushland fringe, and our service radius here also takes in nearby Mount Kuring-Gai. Family homes with plenty of timber, so prep and protection matter.

Berowra 2081 · Northern bushland

Berowra painting

At the LGA’s northern edge, Berowra and adjoining Berowra Heights are semi-rural and heavily treed. Exteriors here work hard against moisture and leaf debris, so we prep thoroughly and coat for the long run.

North Epping 2121 · Bushland enclave

North Epping painting

North Epping is a quiet residential pocket bordering Lane Cove National Park, full of solid mid-century homes. Shaded, damp-prone exteriors here benefit from mould-resistant systems and unhurried preparation.

No drawn-out sales process. Just a clear path from your first call to a job done right.

Local conditions and local homes call for specific skills. These are ours.

Heritage

Federation & period homes

Across Beecroft and Cheltenham we paint character homes the way they deserve: careful surface prep, timber restoration, and historically appropriate colour schemes that respect a conservation-area streetscape. We keep the detail sharp and the finish authentic.

Bushland exteriors

Homes on the tree line

In Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Berowra and North Epping, exteriors face strong sun, moisture, shade and leaf debris. We answer with thorough prep, mould-resistant coatings and durable finishes suited to timber, brick and render. Built to hold up, not just look good on day one.

Every property type

Weatherboard to apartments

The LGA is a real mix, so we are set up for all of it: weatherboard cottages, brick houses, rendered exteriors, unit blocks and modern family homes. Different surfaces, different systems, one crew that knows which is which.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Booking, quotes & cover

Common questions before you book

The practical stuff: how quotes work, what is included, and how we are covered.

How do I get a quote for painting on the Upper North Shore?
Call us on 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We book a time, come out to see the job, and give you a fixed price in writing. The quote is free and there is no call-out fee.
Is the quote really free, with no call-out fee?
Yes. The site visit and the written quote cost you nothing, and we do not charge a call-out fee to come and look. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.
How does your fixed-price quoting work?
We assess the full scope on site, then quote one fixed figure that covers preparation, materials and labour. The price we write down is the price you pay. If you later add work, we quote that separately and clearly before we start it.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold NSW Licence 315254C and our crews are fully insured. We are happy to confirm our licence and insurance details before work begins, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How far ahead should I book?
It depends on the season and the size of the job, so the best move is to call early. We will give you a realistic start window when we quote, and we confirm dates in writing rather than leaving you guessing.
What paint brands do you use?
We use quality, trade-grade products suited to the surface and the conditions, including mould-resistant exterior systems for bushland-edge homes. If you have a preferred brand or an existing colour to match, tell us and we will work to it.
Do you offer colour advice before we commit?
Yes. We are happy to talk through colour and finish options during the quote, including how a scheme will sit on your home and street. For heritage streets we steer toward palettes that suit the era and the area.

props.label: Painting questions specific to the area

Local questions

Painting questions specific to the area

Coverage, heritage streets, bushland exteriors and local approvals.

Which Upper North Shore suburbs do you cover?
All 16 suburbs in the local government area: Asquith, Beecroft, Berowra, Berowra Heights, Cheltenham, Cherrybrook, Hornsby, Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Mount Kuring-Gai, Normanhurst, North Epping, Pennant Hills, Thornleigh, Waitara and Westleigh.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Beecroft and Cheltenham?
Yes, and it is one of the things we do best. Beecroft and Cheltenham sit in a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so we use careful surface preparation, timber restoration where needed, and heritage-appropriate colour schemes that suit the streetscape.
Can you handle bushland-edge exterior painting in Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Berowra and North Epping?
We can. Tree-lined, high-set homes get strong sun, shade, moisture and leaf debris. We prep thoroughly and use mould-resistant coatings and durable finishes made for timber, brick and rendered surfaces so the paint lasts through the seasons.
Do you paint apartments and strata blocks in Waitara?
Yes. Waitara has a lot of unit stock, and we handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas. For strata we give clear written scopes and keep access and noise organised for residents and committees.
How long does an exterior repaint take around here?
It depends on the size of the home, the surface condition and the weather, so we will not guess blind. When we quote on site we give you a realistic timeline for your specific job, and we confirm the dates in writing before we start.
Do you do commercial and office painting across the LGA?
Yes. We paint offices, shopfronts, warehouses and mixed-use commercial sites, scheduled around your trading hours to keep disruption down. Ask for a fixed-price commercial quote when you call.
Do local council heritage rules affect painting my home?
In conservation areas like Beecroft and Cheltenham, external changes can be subject to Hornsby Shire Council heritage controls, so colour and finish choices matter. We work within those expectations and can point you to the right council resources if you need to check before you start.

Local painters, done properly

Painting built for Upper North Shore homes

The Upper North Shore is leafy, high-set and heavily wooded. That looks lovely and it is hard on paint. Homes here cop strong UV, sudden rain, deep tree shade and a constant drift of leaf litter, so exterior coatings have to be prepped thoroughly and chosen to resist moisture and mould. We know the housing stock too, from Federation weatherboards through brick and rendered homes to newer estates and apartment blocks.

We are a small, licensed team that shows up when we say we will. You get one clear fixed-price quote, tidy workmanship, and a crew that treats your place like it is worth protecting. No call-out fee, no vague estimates, no mess left behind. Two decades of work across the LGA sits behind every finish.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Where we work

Suburbs we paint across the LGA

We cover all 16 suburbs in the local government area. Here is what to expect in each pocket, from heritage streets to bushland-edge estates.

Beecroft 2119 & Cheltenham 2119 · Heritage precinct

Beecroft & Cheltenham heritage painting

Beecroft and Cheltenham sit inside a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so the housing is period timber and render on leafy blocks. That calls for gentle preparation, timber restoration where it is needed, and heritage-sympathetic colour schemes rather than a quick once-over. We work carefully here. Older weatherboard and detailed trims reward a painter who slows down, and we colour-match to suit the street without flattening a home’s character.

Waitara 2077 · Rail and apartment belt

Waitara painting

Waitara runs from unit blocks near the station to homes around the hospital precinct. We handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas, and we keep noise and access tidy for shared buildings.

Asquith 2077 · Northern rail corridor

Asquith painting

Asquith is mostly post-war brick and weatherboard family homes. Solid, honest houses that paint up beautifully with the right prep. We refresh tired exteriors and brighten interiors without fuss.

Hornsby Heights 2077 · Bushland edge

Hornsby Heights painting

High-set and tree-lined, Hornsby Heights homes take real sun and shade. Weatherboard and rendered exteriors here need mould-resistant coatings and a proper wash-and-prep before a brush touches them.

Cherrybrook 2126 · Planned estates

Cherrybrook painting

Cherrybrook is largely 1980s and newer estate housing, so think rendered facades, feature walls and full-exterior repaints. We modernise dated colour schemes and seal render against the weather.

Pennant Hills 2120 · Established homes

Pennant Hills painting

Pennant Hills has established station-precinct homes and older weatherboard stock. We repaint fascias, eaves and window frames that have weathered, and we bring interiors back to life room by room.

Thornleigh 2120 · Rail corridor mix

Thornleigh painting

Thornleigh mixes brick, weatherboard and newer builds along the rail line. It is a busy local painter market, so we compete on tidy work and a fixed price you can trust, not on cut corners.

Normanhurst 2076 & Westleigh 2120 · Family suburbs

Normanhurst & Westleigh painting

Normanhurst runs to interwar and post-war homes near the rail line, where we handle full repaints, ceilings and trim work with careful masking. Westleigh is quieter and greener, mostly 1970s and 1980s brick and timber family houses on the bush edge, where exteriors need durable, weather-ready coatings. Both suburbs get the same fixed-price quoting and the same crew.

Mount Colah 2079 · Bushland fringe

Mount Colah painting

Mount Colah sits on the bushland fringe, and our service radius here also takes in nearby Mount Kuring-Gai. Family homes with plenty of timber, so prep and protection matter.

Berowra 2081 · Northern bushland

Berowra painting

At the LGA’s northern edge, Berowra and adjoining Berowra Heights are semi-rural and heavily treed. Exteriors here work hard against moisture and leaf debris, so we prep thoroughly and coat for the long run.

North Epping 2121 · Bushland enclave

North Epping painting

North Epping is a quiet residential pocket bordering Lane Cove National Park, full of solid mid-century homes. Shaded, damp-prone exteriors here benefit from mould-resistant systems and unhurried preparation.

Heritage

Federation & period homes

Across Beecroft and Cheltenham we paint character homes the way they deserve: careful surface prep, timber restoration, and historically appropriate colour schemes that respect a conservation-area streetscape. We keep the detail sharp and the finish authentic.

Every property type

Weatherboard to apartments

The LGA is a real mix, so we are set up for all of it: weatherboard cottages, brick houses, rendered exteriors, unit blocks and modern family homes. Different surfaces, different systems, one crew that knows which is which.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Booking, quotes & cover

Common questions before you book

The practical stuff: how quotes work, what is included, and how we are covered.

How do I get a quote for painting on the Upper North Shore?
Call us on 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We book a time, come out to see the job, and give you a fixed price in writing. The quote is free and there is no call-out fee.
Is the quote really free, with no call-out fee?
Yes. The site visit and the written quote cost you nothing, and we do not charge a call-out fee to come and look. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.
How does your fixed-price quoting work?
We assess the full scope on site, then quote one fixed figure that covers preparation, materials and labour. The price we write down is the price you pay. If you later add work, we quote that separately and clearly before we start it.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold NSW Licence 315254C and our crews are fully insured. We are happy to confirm our licence and insurance details before work begins, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How far ahead should I book?
It depends on the season and the size of the job, so the best move is to call early. We will give you a realistic start window when we quote, and we confirm dates in writing rather than leaving you guessing.
What paint brands do you use?
We use quality, trade-grade products suited to the surface and the conditions, including mould-resistant exterior systems for bushland-edge homes. If you have a preferred brand or an existing colour to match, tell us and we will work to it.
Do you offer colour advice before we commit?
Yes. We are happy to talk through colour and finish options during the quote, including how a scheme will sit on your home and street. For heritage streets we steer toward palettes that suit the era and the area.

props.label: Painting questions specific to the area

Local questions

Painting questions specific to the area

Coverage, heritage streets, bushland exteriors and local approvals.

Which Upper North Shore suburbs do you cover?
All 16 suburbs in the local government area: Asquith, Beecroft, Berowra, Berowra Heights, Cheltenham, Cherrybrook, Hornsby, Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Mount Kuring-Gai, Normanhurst, North Epping, Pennant Hills, Thornleigh, Waitara and Westleigh.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Beecroft and Cheltenham?
Yes, and it is one of the things we do best. Beecroft and Cheltenham sit in a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so we use careful surface preparation, timber restoration where needed, and heritage-appropriate colour schemes that suit the streetscape.
Can you handle bushland-edge exterior painting in Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Berowra and North Epping?
We can. Tree-lined, high-set homes get strong sun, shade, moisture and leaf debris. We prep thoroughly and use mould-resistant coatings and durable finishes made for timber, brick and rendered surfaces so the paint lasts through the seasons.
Do you paint apartments and strata blocks in Waitara?
Yes. Waitara has a lot of unit stock, and we handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas. For strata we give clear written scopes and keep access and noise organised for residents and committees.
How long does an exterior repaint take around here?
It depends on the size of the home, the surface condition and the weather, so we will not guess blind. When we quote on site we give you a realistic timeline for your specific job, and we confirm the dates in writing before we start.
Do you do commercial and office painting across the LGA?
Yes. We paint offices, shopfronts, warehouses and mixed-use commercial sites, scheduled around your trading hours to keep disruption down. Ask for a fixed-price commercial quote when you call.
Do local council heritage rules affect painting my home?
In conservation areas like Beecroft and Cheltenham, external changes can be subject to Hornsby Shire Council heritage controls, so colour and finish choices matter. We work within those expectations and can point you to the right council resources if you need to check before you start.

Painting built for Upper North Shore homes

The Upper North Shore is leafy, high-set and heavily wooded. That looks lovely and it is hard on paint. Homes here cop strong UV, sudden rain, deep tree shade and a constant drift of leaf litter, so exterior coatings have to be prepped thoroughly and chosen to resist moisture and mould. We know the housing stock too, from Federation weatherboards through brick and rendered homes to newer estates and apartment blocks.

We are a small, licensed team that shows up when we say we will. You get one clear fixed-price quote, tidy workmanship, and a crew that treats your place like it is worth protecting. No call-out fee, no vague estimates, no mess left behind. Two decades of work across the LGA sits behind every finish.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Where we work

Suburbs we paint across the LGA

We cover all 16 suburbs in the local government area. Here is what to expect in each pocket, from heritage streets to bushland-edge estates.

Beecroft 2119 & Cheltenham 2119 · Heritage precinct

Beecroft & Cheltenham heritage painting

Beecroft and Cheltenham sit inside a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so the housing is period timber and render on leafy blocks. That calls for gentle preparation, timber restoration where it is needed, and heritage-sympathetic colour schemes rather than a quick once-over. We work carefully here. Older weatherboard and detailed trims reward a painter who slows down, and we colour-match to suit the street without flattening a home’s character.

Waitara 2077 · Rail and apartment belt

Waitara painting

Waitara runs from unit blocks near the station to homes around the hospital precinct. We handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas, and we keep noise and access tidy for shared buildings.

Asquith 2077 · Northern rail corridor

Asquith painting

Asquith is mostly post-war brick and weatherboard family homes. Solid, honest houses that paint up beautifully with the right prep. We refresh tired exteriors and brighten interiors without fuss.

Hornsby Heights 2077 · Bushland edge

Hornsby Heights painting

High-set and tree-lined, Hornsby Heights homes take real sun and shade. Weatherboard and rendered exteriors here need mould-resistant coatings and a proper wash-and-prep before a brush touches them.

Cherrybrook 2126 · Planned estates

Cherrybrook painting

Cherrybrook is largely 1980s and newer estate housing, so think rendered facades, feature walls and full-exterior repaints. We modernise dated colour schemes and seal render against the weather.

Pennant Hills 2120 · Established homes

Pennant Hills painting

Pennant Hills has established station-precinct homes and older weatherboard stock. We repaint fascias, eaves and window frames that have weathered, and we bring interiors back to life room by room.

Thornleigh 2120 · Rail corridor mix

Thornleigh painting

Thornleigh mixes brick, weatherboard and newer builds along the rail line. It is a busy local painter market, so we compete on tidy work and a fixed price you can trust, not on cut corners.

Normanhurst 2076 & Westleigh 2120 · Family suburbs

Normanhurst & Westleigh painting

Normanhurst runs to interwar and post-war homes near the rail line, where we handle full repaints, ceilings and trim work with careful masking. Westleigh is quieter and greener, mostly 1970s and 1980s brick and timber family houses on the bush edge, where exteriors need durable, weather-ready coatings. Both suburbs get the same fixed-price quoting and the same crew.

Mount Colah 2079 · Bushland fringe

Mount Colah painting

Mount Colah sits on the bushland fringe, and our service radius here also takes in nearby Mount Kuring-Gai. Family homes with plenty of timber, so prep and protection matter.

Berowra 2081 · Northern bushland

Berowra painting

At the LGA’s northern edge, Berowra and adjoining Berowra Heights are semi-rural and heavily treed. Exteriors here work hard against moisture and leaf debris, so we prep thoroughly and coat for the long run.

North Epping 2121 · Bushland enclave

North Epping painting

North Epping is a quiet residential pocket bordering Lane Cove National Park, full of solid mid-century homes. Shaded, damp-prone exteriors here benefit from mould-resistant systems and unhurried preparation.

props.label: Specialties

Local conditions and local homes call for specific skills. These are ours.

Heritage

Federation & period homes

Across Beecroft and Cheltenham we paint character homes the way they deserve: careful surface prep, timber restoration, and historically appropriate colour schemes that respect a conservation-area streetscape. We keep the detail sharp and the finish authentic.

Bushland exteriors

Homes on the tree line

In Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Berowra and North Epping, exteriors face strong sun, moisture, shade and leaf debris. We answer with thorough prep, mould-resistant coatings and durable finishes suited to timber, brick and render. Built to hold up, not just look good on day one.

Every property type

Weatherboard to apartments

The LGA is a real mix, so we are set up for all of it: weatherboard cottages, brick houses, rendered exteriors, unit blocks and modern family homes. Different surfaces, different systems, one crew that knows which is which.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Booking, quotes & cover

Common questions before you book

The practical stuff: how quotes work, what is included, and how we are covered.

How do I get a quote for painting on the Upper North Shore?
Call us on 0423 019 087 or send the quote form on this page. We book a time, come out to see the job, and give you a fixed price in writing. The quote is free and there is no call-out fee.
Is the quote really free, with no call-out fee?
Yes. The site visit and the written quote cost you nothing, and we do not charge a call-out fee to come and look. You only pay once you have accepted a fixed price and the work is booked in.
How does your fixed-price quoting work?
We assess the full scope on site, then quote one fixed figure that covers preparation, materials and labour. The price we write down is the price you pay. If you later add work, we quote that separately and clearly before we start it.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold NSW Licence 315254C and our crews are fully insured. We are happy to confirm our licence and insurance details before work begins, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How far ahead should I book?
It depends on the season and the size of the job, so the best move is to call early. We will give you a realistic start window when we quote, and we confirm dates in writing rather than leaving you guessing.
What paint brands do you use?
We use quality, trade-grade products suited to the surface and the conditions, including mould-resistant exterior systems for bushland-edge homes. If you have a preferred brand or an existing colour to match, tell us and we will work to it.
Do you offer colour advice before we commit?
Yes. We are happy to talk through colour and finish options during the quote, including how a scheme will sit on your home and street. For heritage streets we steer toward palettes that suit the era and the area.

props.label: Painting questions specific to the area

Local questions

Painting questions specific to the area

Coverage, heritage streets, bushland exteriors and local approvals.

Which Upper North Shore suburbs do you cover?
All 16 suburbs in the local government area: Asquith, Beecroft, Berowra, Berowra Heights, Cheltenham, Cherrybrook, Hornsby, Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Mount Kuring-Gai, Normanhurst, North Epping, Pennant Hills, Thornleigh, Waitara and Westleigh.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Beecroft and Cheltenham?
Yes, and it is one of the things we do best. Beecroft and Cheltenham sit in a Federation garden-suburb conservation area, so we use careful surface preparation, timber restoration where needed, and heritage-appropriate colour schemes that suit the streetscape.
Can you handle bushland-edge exterior painting in Hornsby Heights, Mount Colah, Berowra and North Epping?
We can. Tree-lined, high-set homes get strong sun, shade, moisture and leaf debris. We prep thoroughly and use mould-resistant coatings and durable finishes made for timber, brick and rendered surfaces so the paint lasts through the seasons.
Do you paint apartments and strata blocks in Waitara?
Yes. Waitara has a lot of unit stock, and we handle apartment interiors, balconies and strata common areas. For strata we give clear written scopes and keep access and noise organised for residents and committees.
How long does an exterior repaint take around here?
It depends on the size of the home, the surface condition and the weather, so we will not guess blind. When we quote on site we give you a realistic timeline for your specific job, and we confirm the dates in writing before we start.
Do you do commercial and office painting across the LGA?
Yes. We paint offices, shopfronts, warehouses and mixed-use commercial sites, scheduled around your trading hours to keep disruption down. Ask for a fixed-price commercial quote when you call.
Do local council heritage rules affect painting my home?
In conservation areas like Beecroft and Cheltenham, external changes can be subject to Hornsby Shire Council heritage controls, so colour and finish choices matter. We work within those expectations and can point you to the right council resources if you need to check before you start.

.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}

.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
